name: Buford Spring (Chassahowitzka WMA)
area: North of Weeki Wachee, Hernando County
coordinateNote: Entrance, parking or campsite coordinates from the November 23, 2026 research.
navigationAddress: Chassahowitzka Wildlife Management Area main entrance, Rattlesnake Camp Road, Weeki Wachee FL
navigationNote: Drive to the main entrance and follow the posted WMA map to the appropriate parking area and boardwalk. Check interior road and gate conditions.
experience: A boardwalk leads from the trailhead through the swamp to a small spring pool that drops past 150 feet. In dry spells the water can be close to unlimited visibility; after heavy rain it goes tannic or green. The best light is around 11 a.m. to 2 p.m. on a clear day. The swimming area is small; it is a freediving and scuba site more than a place to hang out. The water in front of the dock is dangerously shallow: do not jump in. Scuba needs the same state registration as Eagle's Nest; freediving is not covered by that rule.
cost: Daily-use permit $3 per person or $6 per vehicle, paid at the entrance fee station
access: Enter through the Chassahowitzka Wildlife Management Area main gate if the north gate is closed, pay the daily fee, and drive to the Buford trailhead (the pin). Gravel roads, little cell signal, alligators, snakes and biting insects. General gun season Nov 7, 2026 to Jan 3, 2027: wear orange.

conditions.summary: State wildlife agency pages read November 23, 2026 (registration, fees, hunt calendar). Water clarity not checked; it depends on recent rain. (source dated 2026-11-23)
